apiKeys.title: API keys

apiKeys.rateLimit: Each key may send 600 requests per 10 minutes.

empty.description: Create one key per connected system, so you can revoke one without touching the others.

providerKeys.loadError: The provider keys could not be loaded.

webhookForm.name: Name
webhookForm.nameHint: Optional; helps to tell webhooks apart.
webhookForm.urlHint: Local and private network addresses are refused unless the operator allows them.
webhookForm.formatHint: What the requests look like. Chosen from the URL as you enter it; change it if the receiver expects something else.
webhookForm.chatUnsigned: Chat services cannot check a signature, so these messages are sent without one and no secret is shown. Treat the URL like a password: whoever knows it can post to the channel.
webhookForm.newSecret: After saving, {appName} creates a new signing secret for this webhook and shows it once.
webhookForm.eventsHint: {appName} calls the URL for the chosen events. Alert and report rules that name this webhook also send report.alert and report.summary. With no event, it receives only those.

errors.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the URL; the signature authenticates {appName}.

webhookForm.eventsRules: {count, plural, one {# rule under Tenant › Notifications also sends to this webhook.} other {# rules under Tenant › Notifications also send to this webhook.}}

restow.label: {appName} JSON (signed)
restow.description: The event as JSON with an HMAC signature, for RMM, PSA and ticket systems and your own receivers.

discord.label: Discord
discord.description: A message with an embed for a Discord channel webhook. Sent without a signature.

slack.label: Slack
slack.description: A Block Kit message for a Slack incoming webhook. Sent without a signature.

notFound.title: Webhook not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another tenant.

detail.testHint: The test arrives in the chosen format.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate the signing secret?
rotateConfirm.description: A new secret is created and shown once. From the next delivery on, requests are signed with it; the receiving system must be updated.

detail.noEvents: No events subscribed. Edit the webhook and choose at least one, otherwise it receives nothing.
detail.secretMissing: Missing: rotate the secret to create one
detail.secretNotUsed: Not used: chat messages are not signed

pausedNotice.title: This webhook is paused
pausedNotice.description: It receives no events and no test events until it is activated.

deliveries.title: Delivery log
deliveries.description: Every delivery with its attempts. Failed attempts are retried for about a day; finished deliveries are kept for 30 days.
deliveries.empty: No deliveries yet. Send a test event to try the webhook.
deliveries.loadError: The delivery log could not be loaded.
deliveries.eventIdHint: The same for retries and redeliveries; receivers deduplicate by it.
deliveries.payloadHint: The JSON body, as signed and sent.
deliveries.redeliverHint: Sends the same event as a new delivery.

errors.redirect: The receiver redirected (HTTP {status}). Redirects are not followed; use the final URL.
errors.timeout: The receiver did not answer within 10 seconds.
errors.connection_failed: The connection to the receiver failed.
errors.dns_failed: The host name could not be resolved.
errors.tls_failed: The receiver's TLS certificate was not accepted.
errors.blocked_address: The URL points to an address {appName} does not call: loopback and private networks need the operator's approval, link-local (cloud metadata) and reserved ranges are always refused.
errors.secret_missing: The webhook has no signing secret. Rotate the secret to create one.
errors.webhook_disabled: The webhook was paused before this delivery went out.
errors.internal: {appName} could not prepare this delivery. It is retried.

signature.title: Verifying requests
signature.description: Every request is a JSON POST signed with the webhook's secret. Check the signature before trusting a request.
signature.signatureHeader: HMAC-SHA-256 of the raw request body under the signing secret, hex encoded and prefixed with sha256=. Compare in constant time.
signature.deliveryHeader: The delivery ID; the body's id identifies the event across retries.
signature.retries: Any answer other than 2xx counts as a failure and is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 15 min, 1 h, 3 h, 6 h and 12 h. HTTP 410 ends the delivery at once.
signature.chat: Webhooks in the Discord, Slack or Microsoft Teams format receive a readable chat message instead, without a signature and without these headers. An answer of 400, 401, 403, 404, 410, 413 or 422 from the chat service ends such a delivery at once; 429 and server errors are retried, after the time the service asks for.

toasts.testQueued: Test event queued. It appears in the delivery log in a few seconds.
toasts.redelivered: The event is being sent again.

problems.keyLimit: The limit of 50 active API keys is reached. Revoke unused keys first.
problems.webhookLimit: The limit of 20 webhooks per tenant is reached.
problems.featureUnavailable: This is not available on this installation.
problems.webhookPaused: The webhook is paused. Activate it first.
problems.deliveryPending: This delivery is still being attempted. Wait until it has finished.
problems.masterKeyMissing: Secrets cannot be stored: the server has no RESTOW_MASTER_KEY configured.
